description: Look up any US land parcel by street address or parcel number (APN): address, place, APN, state and county, and whether it is already on Fabrica (token ID and property link). For a parcel not on Fabrica, links.addToFabrica is the fabrica.land on-ramp link for that parcel; it starts an on-ramp only when a person opens it and decides there. The tool itself creates nothing. An ambiguous query returns up to 5 candidates, whose Fabrica status is matched by parcel number only; state and county narrow it to one, which gets the full check. When the US parcel search is not answering, properties already on Fabrica that the query names come back from Fabrica's own records as unconfirmed candidates (match: unconfirmed, matchSource: fabrica-index); present them as likely, not confirmed. Owner names from parcel data are never returned. For a list, queries takes up to 10 addresses or parcel numbers under one state and county scope and returns one row per resolved query (onFabrica, tokenId or addToFabrica, coverage) plus an unresolved list with the reason. Limited to 30 lookups per minute per client; each query in a list counts as one.

queries.description: Up to 10 addresses or parcel numbers sharing the same state and county scope; each counts as one lookup against the per-client limit. Returns one row per resolved query and an unresolved list with the reason

query.description: Street address (with city and state when known) or parcel number (APN). Give this or queries, not both

name: find_us_parcel
title: Find a US parcel
